candidate.answerReason: The logarithm log₁₀7 is the exponent to which 10 must be raised to obtain 7.

methods.label: Use the meaning of a logarithm
methods.explanation:
By definition, \(\log_{10}7\) is the exponent \(t\) for which \(10^t=7\). The logarithm is defined because its base \(10\) is positive and different from \(1\), and its argument \(7\) is positive. Therefore
\[
10^{\log_{10}7}=\boxed{7},
\]
which is choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
